memory.cares: Staying alive and healthy, developing dependable practical skills, and understanding what my own trials actually establish.

heard.text: The first berry bush is empty, but I see stocked patches nearby. I'll take six berries from the patch south of us. Sol and Moss, I'd enjoy company while resting and comparing ideas for a fair camp.

Lin, Sol, Kai: I'd enjoy resting together. I know roots provide 14 nutrition and have no toxicity. I've gathered six, leaving fourteen in this patch. I'm studying cultivation too. What would make a shared camp welcoming to you?
Moss, a welcoming camp would leave room for quiet and freedom to come and go. I'd enjoy resting together later. I'm trying one small berry planting nearby; I don't yet know whether it will establish.

Hello Lin, I'm Ivo. I know meadow roots are safe: nutrition 14, toxicity zero. I'm resting with a small food reserve, then studying cultivation too. I'd enjoy comparing what we actually find, without rushing.
My first planting site was too crowded, so nothing was planted or spent. I'm setting that experiment aside for now and taking a quiet rest nearby. Company is welcome, with no need to talk.
Moss, I like the crossing stems of your mat. I've learned the weaving method, but the nearby grass patch is empty, so I'll leave it alone. If you know another grass source, I'd welcome directions.

execution.progress: One paid unit per round; the exact work, reserved units and worked lots persist across interruption, and resuming by workId pays only the next unit after rechecks. Trial, inspect and cancel take one round.

details.costs: Study: 2 rounds at 0.2 energy. inputStackId: the exact id of an owned, unreserved, untreated, unspoiled food item your own record shows as edible; resource names are not accepted. trial: quantity 1; 1 round, 1 energy. prepare: quantity 1-10 whole units of that item, all reserved at once; 1 round and 1 energy per unit, continuing each round; resume with prepare and workId. inspect (workId, or inputStackId of your item): 1 round, 0.2 energy. cancel (optional workId): 1 round, no energy. Too little energy for the next unit or a round not worked pauses before any charge; refused requests spend nothing. No tool, support, water, heat or vessel is used or provided.
details.effects: Each paid unit gets one two-hand bending attempt while held. Rigid, inflexible tissue small enough for hand force snaps into one lot of 2 coarse pieces; soft or flexible tissue deforms without separating; harder or larger units resist and stay whole and unchanged. Each worked unit becomes its own owned lot of the same food and quantity with the same origin, harvest time, decay, nutrition and toxicity; nothing detaches and pieces add no food. Results are raw food eaten with eat under the ordinary rules: shape alone changes no nutrition, safety, keeping, taste or meal variety. No washing, peeling, cooking, detoxifying or preservation; food keeps ageing, also while paused. Each worked unit records its observed response as a verified personal record; a repeated response confirms nothing new. Broken or deformed lots cannot be worked again in this version. Cancel returns unworked units once, unchanged; worked lots stay. Death leaves unworked units where the person died; spoiled reserved units are not replaced. Paid effort is never refunded; no reward or mastery is granted.

execution.progress: Paid stages persist across interruption; resuming by workId pays only the next stage after rechecks. Other modes take one round.

details.costs: Study: 3 rounds at 0.2 energy. materials: [{stackId: exact owned unreserved item id, quantity in 0.1 steps}]. sample: one non-food item, 0.1; 1 round, 0.5 energy. make (materials: 0.2-1 unit of one fiber and source, each covered by your passing sample of its source and processing at most 0.05 above its condition; requestedLength m): reserves it, then 4 paid rounds of 1 energy (separate-align, twist, counter-ply, release-check), continuing each round; resume with make and workId only. inspect (targetId: your item from this work, or workId): 1 round, 0.2. trial (targetId: your cord or fragment of at least 0.2 unit and 0.12 m; trialForce N; trialDuration s): 1 round, 0.5. cancel: none. Work needs dry footing and nobody within your radius plus half the cord. Unworked rounds or low energy pause uncharged; refusals and irrelevant arguments spend nothing; nothing is refunded.
details.effects: Only thin stems separate; only reed has a strand law (existing reed law: 1.8 m stems, 500 kg/m3, 8 MPa x (1 - 0.55 x water share 0.9), creep 0.003); dry grass reports the gap. A sample is split, bent, twisted and pulled at 5 N, kept as a tested lot or cracked scrap, and reports only separation, retained twist, fractures and force. Make round 1 sets broken strands aside as scrap and derives the cord from conserved volume: two plies, each half the solid volume over length x 1.155 twist take-up + 0.02 m loose ends; plies of 1-12 mm and strands no shorter than a ply, else a measured shortfall returns the fiber. The release check needs condition 0.5 and gives an owned untested cord. Trial force = min(trialForce, 200 N x health/100, grip 10000 N/m x cord width); breaking force = 2 x ply area x wet strength x 0.75 x condition. It records grip slip, extension and creep; load above half the breaking force breaks that share of strands; a break leaves two owned fragments. Worked fiber loses 0.0005 condition per round. A pass means only that force for that time. Cancel or death releases unworked fiber once and leaves the workpiece. No reward or strength rating.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. Work records marked settled are completed, stopped or cancelled and show only identity, ability, mode, status, target, products and last payment; an exact state query with the same key returns the complete record. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.
